cohort: The study included 35 patients presenting with cervical dilatation and prolapsed foetal membranes.
finding: Rescue cerclage significantly prolonged pregnancy duration (64 days vs 13.5 days) and increased deliveries after 28 weeks of gestation (63% vs 0%) and take-home baby rates (63%) compared to bed rest in patients with cervical dilatation and membrane prolapse.
cross-section timing: At presentation with cervical dilatation and prolapsed foetal membranes
